svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap: print open end up in black PETG, 100 % infill so no light passes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 46 mm across, 20 mm tall, floor 2 mm, bore 41.6 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Disc: cut 41 mm from 3 mm white PTFE sheet with a knife and file;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sand the top face matte with 400 grit; do not touch it after.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press the disc into the cap, sanded face up; a drop of glue at the edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the cap pushes over the shroud; the bore grips the 42 mm rim and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rim rests on the disc, as it rests on an item when scanning.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The cap mouth stops 0.5 mm below the shroud flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: pushed fully on, the rim touches the disc all round.
